rules.candidate: Topic can be proposed in a weekly list, but must not be drafted.
rules.approved: Type A and Type B-2 topics may proceed through the drafting pipeline.
rules.rejected: Topic should not be drafted unless the representative reopens it.
rules.blocked: Topic needs external confirmation before drafting. Type B-1 client stories stay blocked until client consent and video embed permission are confirmed.

duplicate_audit.summary: Existing EpicKor posts cover K-beauty, markets, snacks, shopping, and Korean industries from consumer/culture/travel angles. These candidates are limited to buyer/operator business intent for /business/.
